instantxp.missing_mycel: Mycel is missing. %s needs the Mycel library to work and stays off until it is installed.
instantxp.bottle.lore: Throw it to get exactly %s XP back
instantxp.config.enabled.desc: Whether nearby XP orbs are picked up instantly.
instantxp.config.radius.desc: Collection radius in blocks around each player.
instantxp.config.xpBottles.desc: Sneak and use an empty glass bottle to bottle your XP; throwing it gives exactly that XP back.
instantxp.config.bottleXp.desc: XP points put into one bottle (or less, if you have less).
instantxp.config.xpCounter.desc: Show the XP you just picked up above the hotbar (+37 XP).
instantxp.config.deathBottle.desc: When you die, part of your XP is left in a Bottle o' Enchanting instead of a few orbs.
instantxp.config.deathBottlePercent.desc: How much of your XP goes into the death bottle, in percent.
